correctness.rationale: The complete all-size argument reduces excursion contacts to two independent conditional ballot halves, proves half-law log-concavity and adjacent-height reverse likelihood-ratio ordering by exact binomial ratios, uses Toeplitz TP2 convolution closure, and handles the zero-midpoint mandatory contact by a log-concave shift. Strict stochastic order follows by support differences, and the covariance claims by monotone regression. The embedded standalone code reproduces 1,430,938 integer-exact assertions: complete Dyck enumeration to semilength 11, all reverse two-by-two minors to 80, independent half-profile DP to 150. Finite checks are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: Distinct conditional joint-distribution statement, not a restatement of a Catalan coefficient formula. Searches compared the reverse two-by-two midpoint-contact kernel, its likelihood-ratio equivalent, all nondecreasing covariance inequalities, and stronger literature on Dyck contact polynomials and random-walk local times. Full texts inspected do not state or imply the conditional reverse-TP2 theorem; historical implicit coverage by inaccessible older joint local-time papers remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: Relevant older conditional-random-walk joint-distribution papers (1986 and 1994) were not available in full text and could contain an implicit stronger formula or comparison.
Likelihood-ratio total-positivity criteria are classical; an unlocated older joint enumeration may imply the result through a known generic theorem.
Search and inspected sources are not an exhaustive priority certificate.

value.rationale: Zero contacts measure excursion renewal structure, while midpoint height measures excursion geometry. The all-size reverse-TP2 theorem gives an exact negative regression relation for every threshold and transformation and addresses the exceptional zero-midpoint contact boundary; marginal counts and correlation alone do not provide these stronger inequalities.
